messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency and queue depth spike on dedicated-pool-eu1. 3xx/5xx start at 1752468000, error rate 4.8% over baseline :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): I'm on it. Looking at the scaling dashboard now.

sam (sre): I see a sudden tail of long requests from a handful of orgs, concurrent slices maxed. Likely request fanout + large context tokens.

kim (infra): Notifying autoscaling controller — trying to trigger reserve burst. If that fails we'll flip manual override.

alex (oncall): Can someone post the quick mitigation checklist? Priorities: (1) protect control plane, (2) limit noisy tenants, (3) restore p95.

sam (sre): Agreed. Proposed steps: 1) Apply tenant-level rate limit (soft) 2) Enable queue-shed for low-tier requests 3) Toggle reserve-surge on dedicated-pool-eu1 4) Reduce per-req concurrency for embedding jobs

maria (support): Which customers are hit? I have pings from acme-inc and orbit-ai complaining about slow responses. I can send a heads-up once we have a mitigation plan.

devin (platform): I'm ready to run the reserve toggle. Command: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane.api.internal/pools/dedicated-pool-eu1/actions -d '{"action":"enable_reserve_burst","duration_minutes":30}'```

deploy-bot: deploy status: autoscaler-config v2.14 -> success on canary (eu1) :white_check_mark:

kim (infra): autoscaler metrics show canary stable. Devin, please go ahead with manual override if the controller doesn't accept the API.

devin (platform): Manual override done: `pool:dedicated-pool-eu1 reserve_burst=ON (id:rb-202303)` — confirmed by controlplane logs.

sam (sre): After reserve ON: queue depth down 40%, p95 improved from 2.3s -> 1.1s. Error rate down to 1.2%. Looks promising.

alex (oncall): Good. Now apply tenant throttles for top offenders. Sam, can you share the shortlist?

sam (sre): Top offenders by throughput: acme-inc (org_234), orbit-ai (org_776), test-ml (org_042). I recommend per-org concurrent slot reduction from 8 -> 3 and 429-based soft backoff header for excess requests.

maria (support): I'll DM these org owners with an FYI: traffic throttles in place to protect platform stability. Template: "We're seeing high traffic; we've temporarily reduced concurrent slots to preserve service. We'll update when normal capacity returns."

alex (oncall): Implemented tenant throttle rules (config-update applied). Snippet: ```PATCH /tenants/org_234/rate_limit {"concurrency":3,"burst":10}```

deploy-bot: policy rollout: tenant-throttle v3 -> 80% -> healthy.

sam (sre): Observability: p95 now 0.9s, error rate 0.8%. However, a residual increase in small-timeout 502s from a different cluster — monitoring.

kim (infra): Noted. I'm shifting some non-Dedicated background jobs off eu1 to free slots (cron-slice deferrals).

devin (platform): Reserve burst currently scheduled for 30m. If we need longer, we should extend to 2 hours and open a billing notification for reserved capacity usage.

alex (oncall): Let's extend to 90 minutes for safety. Devin please extend and set a follow-up check at +30m.

devin (platform): Extended reserve_burst -> 90m. Control plane id rb-202303 updated.

maria (support): Sent notification to affected customers: acme-inc, orbit-ai, test-ml. Included RCA placeholder and ETA for normal ops.

sam (sre): Running a targeted debug on orbit-ai traces — large batch embedding jobs are the root cause, spike aligns with their cron windows. Recommend asking them to postpone heavy batches for the next 2 hours.

maria (support): Making the ask now.

alex (oncall): Next: document actions in incident ticket, set severity 2, and schedule postmortem if reserve was used >60m.

sam (sre): Adding follow-ups: 1) Adjust autoscaler threshold to trigger earlier on queue depth. 2) Add tenant-level early throttling heuristic for batch embedding patterns. 3) Improve billing/alerting for reserve burst usage.

kim (infra): Also adding: synth checks that emulate large-batch arrival so reserve spin-up can be validated during off-hours.

devin (platform): Logging this: ```EVENT reserve_burst rb-202303 user=devin duration=90m trigger=manual```. Ticket: INC-2023-482.

alex (oncall): All good for now — monitoring stable, p95 < 1s. If anything regresses, re-open thread. Great cross-team work :raised_hands:

maria (support): Customers acknowledged and appreciated the proactive head-up. Closing customer comms loop.

sam (sre): Leaving a small note for postmortem: consider circuit-breaker for large-context requests and per-model cost heuristics.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=2, status=mitigated, lead=alex, incident_ticket=INC-2023-482.

alex (oncall): I'll draft the postmortem with action items and share in #postmortems. Thanks everyone.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from sam, kim, devin)
